description: Agent-framework selection matrix, keyed by the cloud decision. The architecture stage picks the cloud; the winning cloud advisor then recommends the agent framework from this matrix (one recommendation + alternates with reasons, per Constitution Art. 5). dev-spec records the choice; build mode scaffolds against it.

crossCloud.tools_and_connectors: MCP (Model Context Protocol) — the connector layer regardless of cloud
crossCloud.agent_interop: A2A (Agent2Agent protocol) — when agents from different frameworks/vendors must talk
crossCloud.note: Framework choice is an ARCHITECTURE decision, not a default. A single-agent pipeline with deterministic steps may need no framework at all — plain SDK calls beat a framework it doesn't need (simplest-thing-that-meets-the-metric rule).

gcp.platform: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (announced Cloud Next, April 2026 — the evolution/rename of Vertex AI, absorbing Agentspace). Bundles ADK (code-first), Agent Studio (low-code), Workspace Studio (no-code), Agent Engine (managed runtime), Model Garden (200+ models incl. Gemini 3.1 and Anthropic Claude), managed MCP servers with Apigee API-to-agent bridge, and A2A v1.0.

recommended.name: Google ADK v1.0 on Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform
recommended.why: First-party, code-first (stable in four languages), Gemini-native with Model Garden access to 200+ models incl. Claude, built-in evaluation, persistent memory, enterprise governance, managed MCP; deploys to the managed Agent Engine runtime; A2A v1.0 for interop.
recommended.deploy: Agent Engine (managed runtime) or Cloud Run / GKE (self-managed)

alternates.name: Agent Studio / Workspace Studio
alternates.when: low-code or no-code builders for business-user agents

alternates.name: CrewAI
alternates.when: lightweight role-based crews without deep GCP coupling

aws.platform: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore — GA (AWS Summit NY 2026). Managed agent harness (CreateHarness/InvokeHarness — no orchestration code or containers), built-in memory, AWS-curated skills catalog, AgentCore Evaluations + Policy (GA), AgentCore CLI, unified observability, Bedrock Mantle for third-party models (incl. OpenAI GPT-5.5) and LiteLLM providers, export-to-Strands.

recommended.name: Strands Agents SDK + Bedrock AgentCore (GA)
recommended.why: Strands is AWS's open-source, model-driven agent SDK (AgentCore's managed harness runs a Strands supervisor under the hood and exports to Strands code); AgentCore GA adds default memory, Evaluations, Policy, versioned endpoints, and the skills catalog — production plumbing you don't build.
recommended.deploy: Bedrock AgentCore (managed harness or runtime) or ECS/EKS/Lambda (self-managed)

alternates.name: AgentCore managed harness only (no SDK)
alternates.when: two-API-call setup — define with CreateHarness, run with InvokeHarness; configuration over code

alternates.name: LangGraph or Claude Agent SDK on AgentCore
alternates.when: AgentCore ships first-class patterns for both; existing estate in either

alternates.name: CrewAI on ECS/EKS
alternates.when: simple role-based multi-agent with minimal infra

azure.platform: Microsoft Foundry (2026 rename of Azure AI Foundry). Foundry Agent Service hosted agents GA (~July 2026): sandboxed sessions, state, filesystem, bring-any-framework (Agent Framework, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Anthropic Agent SDK, GitHub Copilot SDK, or custom containers); Responses API as single entry point; memory (procedural/user/session) in preview; publish to Teams + M365 Copilot; Foundry Toolkit for VS Code GA.

recommended.name: Microsoft Agent Framework + Foundry Agent Service (hosted agents)
recommended.why: Agent Framework is Microsoft's converged open-source successor to Semantic Kernel + AutoGen with stable orchestration building blocks; hosted agents give a managed production runtime with sessions, state, Entra ID governance, and direct publishing into Teams/M365 Copilot where enterprise users already live.
recommended.deploy: Foundry Agent Service hosted agents (managed) or AKS/Container Apps (self-managed)

alternates.name: OpenAI Agents SDK / Anthropic Agent SDK on hosted agents
alternates.when: Foundry hosts both natively; teams standardized on either SDK

alternates.name: Semantic Kernel / AutoGen (legacy)
alternates.when: existing estates — migrate toward Agent Framework

alternates.name: LangGraph on AKS
alternates.when: portability across clouds is a hard requirement

recommended.name: LangGraph (self-hosted) over vLLM/Ollama-served open models
recommended.why: Mature, self-hostable graph orchestration with no vendor runtime dependency; pairs with vLLM/Ollama serving, Milvus/pgvector retrieval, Airflow scheduling — fully inside the boundary.
recommended.deploy: Kubernetes/OpenShift; models via vLLM or Ollama; no external control plane

alternates.name: CrewAI (self-hosted)
alternates.when: lighter role-based crews, smaller ops footprint

alternates.name: Plain function-calling loop (no framework)
alternates.when: single agent + deterministic tools — the simplest thing that meets the metric
